shadows.name: subtle-lift
shadows.purpose: Very subtle separation for main cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High visibility CTA for moving forward.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #BFFF00; color: #111827; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: bold; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s; width: 100%; font-size: 16pt; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.02); background: #9FE800; }

components.name: Action Pill
components.css: .ds-action-pill { background: #111827; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: bold; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12pt; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Main container for simulations and data.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: sans-serif; color: #4B5563; } .ds-card h3 { color: #111827; margin-top: 0; }

narrative.overview: The system balances a clean, innovative, and data-grounded aesthetic with subtle tactile interactions. It provides a bright, high-contrast default environment designed to make career simulations feel accessible and actionable. For specialized contexts, like the Hackathon, the platform shifts to a deeply immersive, bioluminescent dual-theme. The system explicitly rejects rigid enterprise UI patterns.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic, vibrant accents that guide the user.
Distinct immersive sub-themes for special experiences.

rules.name: The Dual-Thematic Rule
rules.body: The primary app remains bright and clean. Deep, dark backgrounds (#03050a) and glowing borders are reserved exclusively for immersive experiences like the Hackathon.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Avoid heavy or layered shadows. Distinct cards should be recognizable through color contrast and generous internal padding.

dos: Do use large, generous touch targets and padding.
Do leverage pure white cards on off-white backgrounds to create structure.
Do use Passion Neon (#BFFF00) for primary, forward-moving actions.
donts: Don't use Microsoft-style corporate, dry, or rigid enterprise UI patterns.
Don't use heavy drop shadows or glassmorphism as a default outside of immersive hackathon contexts.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right greater than 1px) as colored accents.
Don't use modal dialogs as the first thought; rely on inline or progressive alternatives.
